integrity_statement: Self-contained classification proof and ordinary reproducible adjacency enumeration; no authorship or independent certification claim.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labeled crown graphs with \(n\ge3\), not arbitrary bipartite graphs.
The scalar minimum may be implied by existing domination-number inequalities; the main contribution is the entire function enumerator.
Unindexed equivalent work remains possible; 2024 indexed survey and Cartesian-product study were not fully readable.
No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Total Roman \(\{2\}\) weight enumerator of crown graphs
